title: Derivatives of sarcodonin A isolated from Sarcodon scabrosus reversed LPS-induced M1 polarization in microglia through MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Cao, Chen-Yu; Yang, Ying-Xiang; Xie, Zhao; Chen, Xin; Shi, Xin-Wei; Yin, Xia; Gao, Jin-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物sarcodonin A衍生物通过MAPK/NF-kappaB通路逆转小胶质细胞M1极化，分子对接仅涉及iNOS，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Emerging evidence suggests the regulation of microglial phenotype balance between M1 and M2 will be a potential therapeutic strategy for microglia-mediated neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Herein, we evaluated the anti-neuroinflammatory effects and the underlying mechanism of a natural cyathane diterpenoid sarcodonin A (1) derived from the mushroom Sarcodon scabrosus and its six new derivatives (2-7). Lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-activated primary microglia and microglia cell lines were used as models. The nitrite test and immunostaining showed that the derivative named 6 was more effective in inhibiting neuroinflammation. qRT-PCR, ELISA, and western blotting revealed that 6 showed more significant suppression on mRNA and protein expression of proinflammatory M1 markers of TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta, iNOS, and COX-2, while more obvious potentiation on mRNA and protein levels of anti-inflammatory M2 markers of IL-10 and ARG-1. In mechanism, western blotting demonstrated that 6 inhibited LPS-induced activation of MAPK, and prevented LPS-stimulated nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65. Molecular docking revealed that 1 and 6 constructed interactions with iNOS. Collectively, the present study indicated that 1 and 6 might support neuroprotection by reversing LPS-induced microglia M1 polarization, implying that sarcodonin A can be a promising candidate for developing new therapeutics against AD by targeting microglia-mediated neuroinflammation.
abstract_zh: 新出现的证据表明，调节小胶质细胞M1和M2表型平衡可能成为阿尔茨海默病（AD）中小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症的潜在治疗策略。在此，我们评估了一种源自蘑菇Sarcodon scabrosus的天然氰烷二萜类化合物sarcodonin A（1）及其六个新衍生物（2-7）的抗神经炎症作用及其潜在机制。使用脂多糖（LPS）激活的原代小胶质细胞和小胶质细胞系作为模型。亚硝酸盐测试和免疫染色显示，名为6的衍生物在抑制神经炎症方面更为有效。qRT-PCR、ELISA和western blotting揭示，6对促炎性M1标志物TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、iNOS和COX-2的mRNA和蛋白表达具有更显著的抑制作用，同时对抗炎性M2标志物IL-10和ARG-1的mRNA和蛋白水平具有更明显的增强作用。在机制上，western blotting证明6抑制了LPS诱导的MAPK激活，并阻止了LPS刺激的NF-κB p65核转位。分子对接显示1和6与iNOS构建了相互作用。总之，本研究表明1和6可能通过逆转LPS诱导的小胶质细胞M1极化来支持神经保护，暗示sarcodonin A可作为开发针对AD新疗法的有前景候选物，通过靶向小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症。
